messages.subject: simdata - rasch model
parts:
Hello there!

I would like to simulate Rasch conform data with given thetas and betas. That is my code so far:

library(mirt)
beta <- c(2,1,3)
theta <- as.matrix(rnorm(10000,0,1.5))
tmp <- simdata(a=NA, Theta=theta, itemtype ="dich", d = beta)
tmp

However, tmp returns only response patterns for one item, when in my understanding it should return response patterns for three items.
Can anybody tell me, where my code is wrong?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: simdata - rasch model
parts:
You need to specify an 'a' input not matter what, so in this case you probably want to specify 

a <- matrix(1, length(beta))

and pass this to simdata(). Also, d is typically a matrix, so just wrap that in a matrix first before passing it. HTH.

Phil
